The Raiffeisen Diana Haus opened in 2000. The best source is a 2000 press release on the house's reopening, which names the Raiffeisen data centre as one of its tenants. The operator's own history pages confirm that the company moved in that year, but they don't name a separate data-centre opening date.

- The building was opened in 2000 alongside the Dianabad, and it houses the Raiffeisen data centre.
